title: Feature Polish & Launch Readiness Audit
observations: Documentation-only 6-phase pipeline was 2.3× over-engineered; lightweight 3-phase pipeline recommended for future audits. Review caught real accuracy issues (phantom test files, count mismatches, exposed key). Three-pass methodology (static+live+test-coverage) was appropriate. Architecture critique's warnings about router/API-only features proved accurate. Recommendation: lightweight architecture, skip critique for doc workpackages, add explicit verification commands (find, curl) instead of heuristics.
